items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: He played the tenor like, like, like Trombone played the C Melodies, see?

ctx.x: He played, he played, he liked the way Trombone played. He played the tenor like, like, like Trombone played the C Melodies, see? Yeah. Well, anyway, we got together. Jack, uh, Jack made a deal, and we were gonna make some rackets, see? So we took this band on, down there. But I don't know what happened to the masters. I don't know, they just never produced them, you understand?
Well, I think it did, the piano didn't record well, it's what Johnny told me, if I remember the correctly. Because it's been...
